question: Who makes Fairoils avocado oil
markdown:
Fairoils avocado oil
is produced directly by
Fairoils
, an ethical natural oil producer founded in 2013 by
Campbell Walter
and
Wayne Barratt
. The company manufactures its virgin avocado oil
through a Fair Trade certified project, sourcing avocados from small-scale farmers in the Kenyan highlands (such as Thika and Embu) and processing them at their facility in Athi River, Kenya.
